 type Batch struct {
 	batchInternal
 	applied atomic.Bool
-	// lifecycle is used to negotiate the lifecycle of a Batch. A Batch and its
-	// underlying batchInternal.data byte slice may be reused. There are two
-	// mechanisms for reuse:
-	//
-	// 1. The caller may explicitly call [Batch.Reset] to reset the batch to be
-	//    empty (while retaining the underlying repr's buffer).
-	// 2. The caller may call [Batch.Close], passing ownership off to Pebble,
-	//    which may reuse the batch's memory to service new callers to
-	//    [DB.NewBatch].
-	//
-	// There's a complication to reuse: When WAL failover is configured, the
-	// Pebble commit pipeline may retain a pointer to the batch.data beyond the
-	// return of [Batch.Commit]. The user of the Batch may commit their batch
-	// and call Close or Reset before the commit pipeline is finished reading
-	// the data slice. Recycling immediately would cause a data race.
-	//
-	// To resolve this data race, this [lifecycle] atomic is used to determine
-	// safety and responsibility of reusing a batch. The low bits of the atomic
-	// are used as a reference count (really just the lowest bit—in practice
-	// there's only 1 code path that references). The [Batch] is passed into
-	// [wal.Writer]'s WriteRecord method as a [RefCount] implementation. The
-	// wal.Writer guarantees that if it will read [Batch.data] after the call to
-	// WriteRecord returns, it will increment the reference count. When it's
-	// complete, it'll unreference through invoking [Batch.Unref].
-	//
-	// When the committer of a batch indicates intent to recycle a Batch through
-	// calling [Batch.Reset] or [Batch.Close], the lifecycle atomic is read. If
-	// an outstanding reference remains, it's unsafe to reuse Batch.data yet. In
-	// [Batch.Reset] the caller wants to reuse the [Batch] immediately, so we
-	// discard b.data to recycle the struct but not the underlying byte slice.
-	// In [Batch.Close], we set a special high bit [batchClosedBit] on lifecycle
-	// that indicates that the user will not use [Batch] again and we're free to
-	// recycle it when safe. When the commit pipeline eventually calls
-	// [Batch.Unref], the [batchClosedBit] is noticed and the batch is
-	// recycled.
+
+	walSyncWG    sync.WaitGroup
+	applyDone    atomic.Bool
+	syncDone     atomic.Bool
+	durableFired atomic.Bool
+
+	commit    sync.WaitGroup
+	fsyncWait sync.WaitGroup
+
+	commitStats BatchCommitStats
+
+	commitErr error
+
+	ingestedSSTBatch bool
+	committing       bool
+
 	lifecycle atomic.Int32
 }

 	// sync.Pool), and only that struct needs to outlive Batch.Close (which
 	// could then be called immediately after ApplyNoSyncWait). commitStats
 	// will also need to be in this separate struct.
-	commit    sync.WaitGroup

-
-	commitStats BatchCommitStats

-	commitErr error

-	// Position bools together to reduce the sizeof the struct.
-
-	// ingestedSSTBatch indicates that the batch contains one or more key kinds

-	// InternalKeyKindExcise. If the batch contains key kinds of IngestSST*/Excise
-	// then it will only contain key kinds of IngestSST/Excise.
-	ingestedSSTBatch bool
-
-	// committing is set to true when a batch begins to commit. It's used to
-	// ensure the batch is not mutated concurrently. It is not an atomic
-	// deliberately, so as to avoid the overhead on batch mutations. This is
-	// okay, because under correct usage this field will never be accessed

@@ -1627,6 +1593,9 @@ func (b *Batch) reset() {
 		db:       b.db,
 	}
 	b.applied.Store(false)
+	b.applyDone.Store(false)
+	b.syncDone.Store(false)
+	b.durableFired.Store(false)
 	if b.data != nil {
 		if cap(b.data) > b.opts.maxRetainedSizeBytes {
 			// If the capacity of the buffer is larger than our maximum
@@ -2532,3 +2501,34 @@ func batchSort(
 func init() {
 	private.BatchSort = batchSort
 }
+
+func (b *Batch) markApplied(d *DB) {
+	b.applyDuration = time.Since(b.applyStart)
+	if b.applyDuration <= 0 {
+		b.applyDuration = time.Nanosecond
+	}
+	b.applyDone.Store(true)
+	b.maybeFireDurable(d)
+}
+
+func (b *Batch) markWALSynced(d *DB) {
+	b.syncDuration = time.Since(b.syncStart)
+	if b.syncDuration <= 0 {
+		b.syncDuration = time.Nanosecond
+	}
+	b.syncDone.Store(true)
+	b.maybeFireDurable(d)
+}
+
+func (b *Batch) maybeFireDurable(d *DB) {
+	if !b.syncWAL {
+		return
+	}
+	if b.applyDone.Load() && b.syncDone.Load() {
+		if b.durableFired.CompareAndSwap(false, true) {
+			if d != nil {
+				d.onBatchDurable(b)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
diff --git a/batch_durable_test.go b/batch_durable_test.go

index 00000000..969a1660
--- /dev/null
+++ b/batch_durable_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,355 @@
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/vfs"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestBatchDurableAndDurabilityAPIs(t *testing.T) {
+	memFS := vfs.NewMem()
+
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	var durableEvents []BatchDurableInfo
+
+	el := EventListener{
+		BatchDurable: func(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+			mu.Lock()
+			durableEvents = append(durableEvents, info)
+			mu.Unlock()
+		},
+	}
+
+	opts := &Options{
+		FS:            memFS,
+		EventListener: &el,
+	}
+
+	db, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer func() {
+		if db != nil {
+			_ = db.Close()
+		}
+	}()
+
+	// Initial DurabilityStats before any commits
+	stats := db.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Equal(t, base.SeqNum(0), stats.HighestDurableSeqNum)
+	require.Nil(t, stats.FirstErr)
+	require.Equal(t, int64(0), stats.PendingWaiters)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(0), stats.TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(0), stats.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Equal(t, time.Duration(0), stats.CumulativeSyncDuration)
+	require.Equal(t, time.Duration(0), stats.MaxSyncDuration)
+
+	// Test 1: Sync commit
+	wo := &WriteOptions{
+		Sync:                true,
+		CommitCorrelationID: 42,
+	}
+
+	batch := db.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, batch.Set([]byte("key1"), []byte("val1"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, batch.Set([]byte("key2"), []byte("val2"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, batch.Commit(wo))
+
+	// Verify BatchDurable event fired
+	mu.Lock()
+	require.Len(t, durableEvents, 1)
+	ev := durableEvents[0]
+	mu.Unlock()
+
+	require.Greater(t, ev.JobID, 0)
+	require.Greater(t, ev.SeqNum, base.SeqNum(0))
+	require.Nil(t, ev.Err)
+	require.Greater(t, ev.ApplyDuration, time.Duration(0))
+	require.Greater(t, ev.SyncDuration, time.Duration(0))
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(42), ev.CorrelationID)
+	require.Equal(t, uint32(2), ev.KeyCount)
+	require.Greater(t, ev.BatchSize, 0)
+
+	// Verify Metrics
+	m := db.Metrics()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), m.DurableCommitCount)
+	require.Greater(t, m.DurableCommitDuration, time.Duration(0))
+
+	// Verify DurabilityStats after 1 commit
+	stats = db.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Greater(t, stats.HighestDurableSeqNum, base.SeqNum(0))
+	require.Nil(t, stats.FirstErr)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), stats.TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(0), stats.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Greater(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration, time.Duration(0))
+	require.Greater(t, stats.MaxSyncDuration, time.Duration(0))
+
+	// Verify DurableState
+	highSeq, stateErr := db.DurableState()
+	require.NoError(t, stateErr)
+	require.Equal(t, stats.HighestDurableSeqNum, highSeq)
+
+	// Test 2: WaitForDurability for seqNum == 0 and durable seqNum
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForDurability(0))
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForDurability(ev.SeqNum))
+
+	// Test 3: WaitForDurabilityBatch
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForDurabilityBatch(nil))
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{}))
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{0, ev.SeqNum}))
+
+	// Test 4: WaitForJobDurability
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForJobDurability(ev.JobID))
+
+	// Test 5: Unknown and zero job IDs
+	errUnknown := db.WaitForJobDurability(0)
+	require.Error(t, errUnknown)
+	require.True(t, strings.Contains(errUnknown.Error(), "unknown"))
+
+	errUnknown2 := db.WaitForJobDurability(99999)
+	require.Error(t, errUnknown2)
+	require.True(t, strings.Contains(errUnknown2.Error(), "unknown"))
+
+	// Test 6: DurabilityNotify
+	notifyCh := db.DurabilityNotify(ev.SeqNum)
+	require.Nil(t, <-notifyCh)
+
+	// Test 7: Non-sync commit should NOT trigger BatchDurable
+	batchNoSync := db.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, batchNoSync.Set([]byte("key3"), []byte("val3"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, batchNoSync.Commit(NoSync))
+
+	mu.Lock()
+	require.Len(t, durableEvents, 1) // still 1
+	mu.Unlock()
+
+	require.NoError(t, db.Close())
+	db = nil
+}
+
+func TestBatchDurableNotConfiguredMetrics(t *testing.T) {
+	memFS := vfs.NewMem()
+	opts := &Options{
+		FS: memFS,
+		// EventListener.BatchDurable is NOT configured
+	}
+
+	db, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer db.Close()
+
+	batch := db.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, batch.Set([]byte("k"), []byte("v"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, batch.Commit(Sync))
+
+	m := db.Metrics()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(0), m.DurableCommitCount)
+	require.Equal(t, time.Duration(0), m.DurableCommitDuration)
+}
+
+func TestDurabilityDisableWAL(t *testing.T) {
+	memFS := vfs.NewMem()
+	var durableFired bool
+	opts := &Options{
+		FS:         memFS,
+		DisableWAL: true,
+		EventListener: &EventListener{
+			BatchDurable: func(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+				durableFired = true
+			},
+		},
+	}
+
+	db, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer db.Close()
+
+	batch := db.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, batch.Set([]byte("k"), []byte("v"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, batch.Commit(NoSync))
+
+	require.False(t, durableFired)
+
+	// Wait APIs with DisableWAL return nil immediately
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForDurability(100))
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{1, 2, 3}))
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForJobDurability(1))
+
+	notifyCh := db.DurabilityNotify(100)
+	require.Nil(t, <-notifyCh)
+}
+
+func TestWaitForJobDurabilityExpired(t *testing.T) {
+	memFS := vfs.NewMem()
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	var events []BatchDurableInfo
+	opts := &Options{
+		FS: memFS,
+		EventListener: &EventListener{
+			BatchDurable: func(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+				mu.Lock()
+				events = append(events, info)
+				mu.Unlock()
+			},
+		},
+	}
+
+	db, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer db.Close()
+
+	// Set a very small retention window to force eviction
+	db.durability.retainedJobCap = 2
+
+	// Commit 5 batches
+	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
+		b := db.NewBatch()
+		require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("k"), []byte("v"), nil))
+		require.NoError(t, b.Commit(Sync))
+	}
+
+	mu.Lock()
+	require.Len(t, events, 5)
+	firstJobID := events[0].JobID
+	lastJobID := events[4].JobID
+	mu.Unlock()
+
+	// firstJobID should be evicted and return "expired" error
+	errExpired := db.WaitForJobDurability(firstJobID)
+	require.Error(t, errExpired)
+	require.True(t, strings.Contains(errExpired.Error(), "expired"))
+
+	// lastJobID should still be in retention window
+	require.NoError(t, db.WaitForJobDurability(lastJobID))
+}
+
+func TestTeeEventListenerBatchDurable(t *testing.T) {
+	var count1, count2 int
+	el1 := EventListener{
+		BatchDurable: func(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+			count1++
+		},
+	}
+	el2 := EventListener{
+		BatchDurable: func(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+			count2++
+		},
+	}
+
+	tee := TeeEventListener(el1, el2)
+	opts := &Options{
+		FS:            vfs.NewMem(),
+		EventListener: &tee,
+	}
+
+	db, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer db.Close()
+
+	b := db.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("k"), []byte("v"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, b.Commit(Sync))
+
+	require.Equal(t, 1, count1)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, count2)
+
+	m := db.Metrics()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), m.DurableCommitCount)
+}
+
+func TestDurabilityCloseUnblocksWaiters(t *testing.T) {
+	memFS := vfs.NewMem()
+	db, err := Open("", &Options{FS: memFS})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	var wg sync.WaitGroup
+	var err1, err2 error
+
+	wg.Add(2)
+	go func() {
+		defer wg.Done()
+		err1 = db.WaitForDurability(1000)
+	}()
+	go func() {
+		defer wg.Done()
+		ch := db.DurabilityNotify(1000)
+		err2 = <-ch
+	}()
+
+	time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
+	require.NoError(t, db.Close())
+
+	wg.Wait()
+	require.Error(t, err1)
+	require.Error(t, err2)
+}
+
+func TestDurabilityContextPrecedence(t *testing.T) {
+	memFS := vfs.NewMem()
+	db, err := Open("", &Options{FS: memFS})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	// Commit a batch to get a durable seqNum
+	b := db.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("k"), []byte("v"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, b.Commit(Sync))
+
+	durableSeq, _ := db.DurableState()
+
+	// Pass an ALREADY-cancelled context to WaitForDurabilityContext for an ALREADY-durable seqNum
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel() // cancel immediately
+
+	// Durability success takes precedence over context cancellation
+	err = db.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, durableSeq)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	require.NoError(t, db.Close())
+}
+
+func TestBatchDurableAsyncSyncCommit(t *testing.T) {
+	memFS := vfs.NewMem()
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	var durableEvents []BatchDurableInfo
+
+	el := EventListener{
+		BatchDurable: func(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+			mu.Lock()
+			durableEvents = append(durableEvents, info)
+			mu.Unlock()
+		},
+	}
+
+	opts := &Options{
+		FS:            memFS,
+		EventListener: &el,
+	}
+
+	db, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer db.Close()
+
+	batch := db.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, batch.Set([]byte("key1"), []byte("val1"), nil))
+	
+	// ApplyNoSyncWait
+	require.NoError(t, db.ApplyNoSyncWait(batch, &WriteOptions{Sync: true, CommitCorrelationID: 99}))
+
+	// Wait for durability via API
+	require.NoError(t, batch.SyncWait())
+
+	mu.Lock()
+	require.Len(t, durableEvents, 1)
+	ev := durableEvents[0]
+	mu.Unlock()
+
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(99), ev.CorrelationID)
+	require.Nil(t, ev.Err)
+	require.Greater(t, ev.ApplyDuration, time.Duration(0))
+	require.Greater(t, ev.SyncDuration, time.Duration(0))
+}

+func (d *DB) closedErr() error {
+	if v := d.closed.Load(); v != nil {

+
+type durabilityManager struct {
+	mu sync.Mutex
+
+	highestDurableSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	firstErr             error
+	totalDurableCommits  uint64
+	totalFailedCommits   uint64
+	cumulativeSyncDur    time.Duration
+	maxSyncDur           time.Duration
+
+	maxJobIDSeen   int
+	retainedJobCap int
+	retainedJobs   map[int]error
+
+	pendingWaiters atomic.Int64
+
+	seqWaiters []durabilityWaiter
+	jobWaiters map[int][]chan struct{}
+
+	maxSubscriptions int
+	subscriptions    map[base.SeqNum][]chan error
+	numSubscriptions int
+
+	closed bool
+}
+
+type durabilityWaiter struct {
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	ch     chan struct{}
+}
+
+func (m *durabilityManager) isSeqDurableLocked(seqNum base.SeqNum) bool {
+	if seqNum == 0 {
+		return m.totalDurableCommits+m.totalFailedCommits > 0 || m.highestDurableSeqNum > 0
+	}
+	return m.highestDurableSeqNum >= seqNum
+}
+
+func (m *durabilityManager) lowestRetainedJobIDLocked() int {
+	lowest := -1
+	for j := range m.retainedJobs {
+		if lowest == -1 || j < lowest {
+			lowest = j
+		}
+	}
+	return lowest
+}
+
+func (m *durabilityManager) evictOldJobsLocked() {
+	if m.retainedJobCap <= 0 {
+		m.retainedJobCap = 4096
+	}
+	for len(m.retainedJobs) > m.retainedJobCap {
+		lowest := m.lowestRetainedJobIDLocked()
+		if lowest != -1 {
+			delete(m.retainedJobs, lowest)
+		} else {
+			break
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func (m *durabilityManager) onBatchDurable(d *DB, b *Batch, info BatchDurableInfo) {
+	m.mu.Lock()
+
+	if b.commitErr == nil {
+		m.totalDurableCommits++
+		endSeqNum := b.SeqNum() + base.SeqNum(b.Count())
+		if endSeqNum > m.highestDurableSeqNum {
+			m.highestDurableSeqNum = endSeqNum
+		}
+	} else {
+		m.totalFailedCommits++
+		if m.firstErr == nil {
+			m.firstErr = b.commitErr
+		}
+	}
+
+	m.cumulativeSyncDur += b.syncDuration
+	if b.syncDuration > m.maxSyncDur {
+		m.maxSyncDur = b.syncDuration
+	}
+
+	if m.retainedJobs == nil {
+		m.retainedJobs = make(map[int]error)
+	}
+	m.retainedJobs[b.jobID] = b.commitErr
+	if b.jobID > m.maxJobIDSeen {
+		m.maxJobIDSeen = b.jobID
+	}
+	m.evictOldJobsLocked()
+
+	// Notify seqWaiters
+	var remainingWaiters []durabilityWaiter
+	for _, w := range m.seqWaiters {
+		if m.isSeqDurableLocked(w.seqNum) || m.firstErr != nil || m.closed {
+			close(w.ch)
+		} else {
+			remainingWaiters = append(remainingWaiters, w)
+		}
+	}
+	m.seqWaiters = remainingWaiters
+
+	// Notify jobWaiters
+	if jobChs, ok := m.jobWaiters[b.jobID]; ok {
+		for _, ch := range jobChs {
+			close(ch)
+		}
+		delete(m.jobWaiters, b.jobID)
+	}
+
+	// Notify subscriptions
+	if m.subscriptions != nil {
+		for seqNum, chList := range m.subscriptions {
+			if m.isSeqDurableLocked(seqNum) || m.firstErr != nil || m.closed {
+				errToDeliver := b.commitErr
+				if m.firstErr != nil {
+					errToDeliver = m.firstErr
+				}
+				for _, ch := range chList {
+					ch <- errToDeliver
+				}
+				m.numSubscriptions -= len(chList)
+				delete(m.subscriptions, seqNum)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	m.mu.Unlock()
+
+	// Fire EventListener outside lock
+	if d != nil && d.opts != nil && d.opts.EventListener != nil {
+		d.opts.EventListener.BatchDurable(info)
+	}
+
+	// Metrics accumulation if configured
+	if d != nil && d.batchDurableConfigured {
+		d.durableCommitCount.Add(1)
+		d.durableCommitDuration.Add(int64(b.syncDuration))
+	}
+}
+
+func (m *durabilityManager) close(closeErr error) {
+	m.mu.Lock()
+	defer m.mu.Unlock()
+
+	m.closed = true
+	if m.firstErr == nil && closeErr != nil {
+		m.firstErr = closeErr
+	}
+	errToDeliver := closeErr
+	if errToDeliver == nil {
+		errToDeliver = ErrClosed
+	}
+
+	for _, w := range m.seqWaiters {
+		close(w.ch)
+	}
+	m.seqWaiters = nil
+
+	for _, chList := range m.jobWaiters {
+		for _, ch := range chList {
+			close(ch)
+		}
+	}
+	m.jobWaiters = nil
+
+	if m.subscriptions != nil {
+		for _, chList := range m.subscriptions {
+			for _, ch := range chList {
+				ch <- errToDeliver
+			}
+		}
+		m.subscriptions = nil
+		m.numSubscriptions = 0
+	}
+}
+
+func (d *DB) onBatchDurable(b *Batch) {
+	info := BatchDurableInfo{
+		JobID:         b.jobID,
+		SeqNum:        b.SeqNum(),
+		Err:           b.commitErr,
+		ApplyDuration: b.applyDuration,
+		SyncDuration:  b.syncDuration,
+		CorrelationID: b.commitCorrelationID,
+		BatchSize:     len(b.data),
+		KeyCount:      b.Count(),
+	}
+	d.durability.onBatchDurable(d, b, info)
+}
+
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurability(seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(context.Background(), seqNum)
+}
+
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	d.durability.pendingWaiters.Add(1)
+	defer d.durability.pendingWaiters.Add(-1)
+
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	if d.durability.firstErr != nil {
+		err := d.durability.firstErr
+		d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := d.closedErr(); err != nil {
+		d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	if d.durability.isSeqDurableLocked(seqNum) {
+		d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	waitCh := make(chan struct{})
+	w := durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: waitCh}
+	d.durability.seqWaiters = append(d.durability.seqWaiters, w)
+	d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+
+	var ctxErr error
+	select {
+	case <-waitCh:
+	case <-ctx.Done():
+		ctxErr = ctx.Err()
+	}
+
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+
+	if d.durability.firstErr != nil {
+		return d.durability.firstErr
+	}
+	if err := d.closedErr(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if d.durability.isSeqDurableLocked(seqNum) {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	return ctxErr
+}
+
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatch(seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(context.Background(), seqNums)
+}
+
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(ctx context.Context, seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	if len(seqNums) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	var maxSeq base.SeqNum
+	for _, s := range seqNums {
+		if s > maxSeq {
+			maxSeq = s
+		}
+	}
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, maxSeq)
+}
+
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurability(jobID int) error {
+	return d.WaitForJobDurabilityContext(context.Background(), jobID)
+}
+
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, jobID int) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	d.durability.pendingWaiters.Add(1)
+	defer d.durability.pendingWaiters.Add(-1)
+
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+
+	if jobID <= 0 || jobID > d.durability.maxJobIDSeen {
+		d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+		return errors.Errorf("unknown job ID %d", jobID)
+	}
+
+	if syncErr, ok := d.durability.retainedJobs[jobID]; ok {
+		d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+		return syncErr
+	}
+
+	lowest := d.durability.lowestRetainedJobIDLocked()
+	if lowest != -1 && jobID < lowest {
+		d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+		return errors.Errorf("job ID %d expired", jobID)
+	}
+
+	if d.durability.jobWaiters == nil {
+		d.durability.jobWaiters = make(map[int][]chan struct{})
+	}
+	waitCh := make(chan struct{})
+	d.durability.jobWaiters[jobID] = append(d.durability.jobWaiters[jobID], waitCh)
+	d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+
+	var ctxErr error
+	select {
+	case <-waitCh:
+	case <-ctx.Done():
+		ctxErr = ctx.Err()
+	}
+
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+
+	if syncErr, ok := d.durability.retainedJobs[jobID]; ok {
+		return syncErr
+	}
+	if d.durability.firstErr != nil {
+		return d.durability.firstErr
+	}
+	if err := d.closedErr(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	lowest = d.durability.lowestRetainedJobIDLocked()
+	if lowest != -1 && jobID < lowest {
+		return errors.Errorf("job ID %d expired", jobID)
+	}
+
+	return ctxErr
+}
+
+func (d *DB) DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+	return d.durability.highestDurableSeqNum, d.durability.firstErr
+}
+
+func (d *DB) DurabilityNotify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	ch := make(chan error, 1)
+
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		ch <- nil
+		return ch
+	}
+
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+
+	if d.durability.firstErr != nil {
+		ch <- d.durability.firstErr
+		return ch
+	}
+	if err := d.closedErr(); err != nil {
+		ch <- err
+		return ch
+	}
+	if d.durability.isSeqDurableLocked(seqNum) {
+		ch <- nil
+		return ch
+	}
+
+	if d.durability.maxSubscriptions <= 0 {
+		d.durability.maxSubscriptions = 4096
+	}
+	if d.durability.numSubscriptions >= d.durability.maxSubscriptions {
+		ch <- errors.New("durability notify subscription limit exceeded")
+		return ch
+	}
+
+	if d.durability.subscriptions == nil {
+		d.durability.subscriptions = make(map[base.SeqNum][]chan error)
+	}
+	d.durability.subscriptions[seqNum] = append(d.durability.subscriptions[seqNum], ch)
+	d.durability.numSubscriptions++
+
+	return ch
+}
+
+func (d *DB) DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats {
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+
+	return DurabilityStats{
+		HighestDurableSeqNum:   d.durability.highestDurableSeqNum,
+		FirstErr:               d.durability.firstErr,
+		PendingWaiters:         d.durability.pendingWaiters.Load(),
+		TotalDurableCommits:    d.durability.totalDurableCommits,
+		TotalFailedCommits:     d.durability.totalFailedCommits,
+		CumulativeSyncDuration: d.durability.cumulativeSyncDur,
+		MaxSyncDuration:        d.durability.maxSyncDur,
+	}
+}
